title: Fortnite returns to Apple's Australian app stores after landmark case
paragraphs: The Federal Court has ordered Apple to open up its devices to other app stores, as part of a landmark finding that the tech giant violated Australian competition law.
It's a fundamental shift for an estimated 15 million Australian Apple users, who will soon be able to download apps from the open web as well as rival app stores as a result.
The company has until March 2027 to make the changes, Federal Court Justice Jonathan Beach ruled on Thursday.
